title: PAARS: Persona Aligned Agentic Retail Shoppers

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the distributional differences between simulated agent populations and real human shopper populations using Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence across e-commerce tasks like search query generation, item selection, and session generation.
Calculating the token-type-ratio (TTR) for search queries and viewed product titles to evaluate the lack of diversity in the outputs of agentic populations compared to real human behavior.
